jobs.description:
Global Wind Service is looking for an experienced Sales Manager to strengthen our Offshore Installation and Offshore Service business in Europe.

This is a key commercial role with responsibility for major opportunities across our offshore business. You will be involved throughout the commercial process, from developing opportunities and responding to complex tenders through commercial negotiations, contract award and handover.

The position offers significant customer exposure and the opportunity to play an important role in the continued development of our offshore business and commercial offering.

About Global Wind Service

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Global Wind Service (GWS) is a leading provider of wind turbine installation and maintenance services. With more than 1,800 employees worldwide, we support wind projects across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific.

As part of the Fred. Olsen Group, we are committed to supporting the global transition to renewable energy through safe and high-quality project delivery, flexibility and strong customer partnerships.

Our business is international and fast-moving. Close cooperation between Sales and Operations is central to developing solutions that meet our customers' needs while reflecting how projects will actually be delivered.

Your Role

As Sales Manager, you will take commercial responsibility for customers and opportunities across Offshore Installation and Offshore Service.

You will work closely with Operations and other internal functions to develop competitive commercial solutions for a variety of project opportunities. A key area of focus will be the continued development of our lump-sum offering, including how operational assumptions, productivity, resources, programme and project risk are translated into a robust commercial model.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Leading complex RFQs and tenders for Offshore Installation and Offshore Service projects

• 
Developing commercial proposals, pricing and project-specific commercial models

• 
Further developing our lump-sum offering, together with the operational and commercial assumptions behind it

• 
Reviewing and challenging project scope, programme, productivity, resource requirements and key interfaces

• 
Identifying, assessing and managing commercial and contractual risks

• 
Leading commercial and contractual negotiations with customers

• 
Managing and developing relationships with key international customers

• 
Coordinating input from Sales, Operations and other relevant functions throughout the tender and contracting process

• 
Maintaining clear commercial alignment through contract award and handover to Operations

• 
Contributing to the continued development of our offshore sales and commercial approach

The position gives you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy in managing your customers and opportunities, while working closely with experienced operational and commercial colleagues.

The role reports to the Head of Offshore Sales and is preferably based from our office in Fredericia, Denmark or Duiven, the Netherlands. Approximately 30–40 travel days per year should be expected for customer meetings, negotiations and project visits.

We are looking for an experienced commercial professional who understands the wind industry and is comfortable taking responsibility for complex project opportunities and customer discussions.

Professional experience within the wind industry is essential for this position. You do not necessarily need to come from Offshore Installation or Offshore Service, but you should understand the commercial and operational environment of wind projects and be able to engage confidently with both customers and internal stakeholders.

You will bring:

• 
Solid professional experience within the wind industry

• 
A strong commercial background, including experience with RFQs, tenders and customer negotiations

• 
A good understanding of wind project execution and the commercial factors that influence a successful project

• 
The ability to understand and challenge the assumptions behind commercial proposals

• 
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify and manage risk

• 
Experience working with international customers and multiple stakeholders

• 
A structured and commercially focused approach with good attention to detail

• 
Strong communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills

• 
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional European languages are an advantage

Experience within Offshore Installation and/or Offshore Service as well as experience on developing lump-sum offerings would be a great advantage.

What We Offer

At Global Wind Service, you will join an international organisation with a strong position in the wind industry and the opportunity to contribute directly to the continued growth of our Offshore Installation and Offshore Service business.

You will work with major international customers and complex offshore projects, with the opportunity to influence how commercial solutions are developed and how we continue to strengthen our offering as the business grows.

We offer:

• 
A high degree of commercial responsibility and autonomy

• 
Direct engagement with leading international wind industry customers

• 
The opportunity to work on major Offshore Installation and Offshore Service opportunities

• 
Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Sales, Operations and other functions

• 
An international working environment across multiple markets

• 
Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Apply Now

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please apply via the link on this page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

For more information about the position, please contact Head of Sales – Tristan Domin +31682787414

TORM is looking for a colleague focused on results to work on reducing on-board energy consumption in close cooperation with external and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to take on a new role impacting TORM’s efforts for reducing CO2 emissions?

Your Role

You will enjoy being part of a team that helps reduce TORM’s environmental footprint and improve/optimize the bottom-line.

The Technical Decarbonization team is responsible for measuring, analyzing and determining actual fleet performance as well as engaging in implementation of projects for fulfilling TORM’s CO2 emission reduction goals.

Apart from reducing fuel consumption, you will be supporting TORM’s Tanker and Technical Divisions by delivering value adding data analysis and decision support by utilizing available data from the fleet and the office.

We are implementing NEXUS, our in-house made common platform for sharing information.

This position will be reporting to Head of Technical Decarbonization and working from TORM’s office in Copenhagen.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Become the NEXUS Master able to follow the data from sensors to the user interface and to qualify whether the data is sufficiently accurate.

• Use your creativity to build User interface models for our NEXUS software.

• Supervise and drive the creation of Automated Guidance making sure they are meaningful and correctly identifies saving opportunities.

• Carry out pilot projects on energy efficiency technologies when new ideas must be tested.

You will also have duties on:

• Daily energy efficiency evaluation and intervening the vessels with significant excess fuel consumption.

• Do vessel visits as and when business activities permit.

• Engage with Senior officers onboard to support constant power & voyage optimization.

• Discuss specific energy efficiency topics with Vessel Managers.

• Coordinate knowledge sharing and collaboration across technical, tanker, and vessel management teams on energy efficiency topics.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate has a background as marine engineer or deck officer with sailing experience, preferably on tankers.

Equally important the person we look for is:

• Result-driven and focused on operational performance.

• Takes personal ownership, works on own initiative and follows tasks through to completion.

• Experience collaborating with vessel crews and shore-based colleagues to identify issues and implement operational improvements.

• Understanding that shipping is a 24/7/365 business and being flexible when occasional work outside normal hours is needed.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Fluent in English, written and spoken

• A cooperative contributor who demonstrates broad cultural awareness and understanding

• Experience from the product tanker industry is a great advantage

As the work environment is very important to us, the right candidate will be one who can contribute to the positive social atmosphere in the team.

What We Offer

A competitive salary which will reflect your experience and qualifications, and an attractive benefits package including bonus, life and health insurance.

Furthermore, we believe in freedom and flexibility under responsibility, so the office hours can be adjusted to accommodate your work life balance.

The team spirit is very important to us, and we value bonding across departments.

Furthermore, we have attractive office buildings with a great lunch scheme.

How to Apply

For further information about the position, please call Head of Technical Decarbonization, Per Moelris (+45) 2072 7270.

Please submit your application and CV via our website www.torm.com/careers/ashore as soon as possible and no later than 25. November 2026.

Applications are evaluated continuously, and interviews will take place as soon as possible.

Your application will be treated professionally, and our reply will be sent to the e-mail address from which you submitted your application.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Supply Manager/ Senior Clinical Trial Supply Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about clinical trial supply management? Do you have experience within GMP/GDP-regulated environments and managing complex clinical trial supply chains?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Clinical Trial Supply Manager.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

As Clinical Trial Supply Manager at Ascendis Pharma, you will be responsible for managing selected areas of the Clinical Trial Supply Chain in collaboration with internal and externally stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) department comprises three closely collaborating teams: CTS - Coordination, CTS-IRT and CTS - Preparation & Handling.

We are seeking a passionate Clinical Trial Supply Manager to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in managing the clinical trial supply activities across Phase 1-3 studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be part of a dedicated and highly experienced Clinical Trial Supply department comprising 12 colleagues. The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will depend on your experience and may include:

• Coordinating internal CTS trial meetings and activities and collaborating with internal departments incl. CMC, Trial Management, QA, IT, and Regulatory Affairs

• Forecasting, planning, and facilitating the supply of IMP for clinical trial supplies, including managing IMP Packaging and Labelling activities, packaging design, label text development, and planning of packaging runs

• Managing IRT setup, incl. IRT specification, UAT preparation and execution, Go-live and close-out, as well as managing IRT system changes after Go-live

• Managing IMP distribution from CMOs to clinical sites incl. direct-to-patient (DtP) shipments and management of temperature excursions during storage at depots and clinical sites and during shipments

• Managing drug accountability activities, including returns, reconciliation and destruction

• Participating in meetings with CMOs, suppliers and vendors, trial teams and Investigator Meetings

• Maintaining documentation in the QMS and eTMF, including reviewing and preparing trial-related instructions and manuals

Qualifications and Skills:

Ideally, you hold a relevant academic degree in pharmacy or a related field and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial supply management or a GMP/GDP-regulated environment.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven experience in managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

• A strong understanding of regulatory requirements

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

Key competencies:

You are a collaborative and quality-focused team player with a structured and analytical approach to your work. You are adaptable, take ownership, and have a can-do attitude. You thrive in a fast-paced, informal environment where priorities may change and close collaboration is key.

Travel: 2–10 days per year

Office: Denmark, Hellerup, Tuborg Havn

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Sara Østergaard, Director Clinical Trial Supply PM Team at sbo@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

In Technical, you will join a team of talented and welcoming colleagues.

You will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and cost-effective technical management of assigned vessels. This includes ensuring compliance with international maritime regulations, oil major requirements, and company standards. The role supports onboard teams in maintaining vessel integrity, managing repairs and overseeing dry-docking activities, while prioritizing safety, environmental protection and operational reliability.

Key responsibilities include

• Manage vessel performance: Ensure assigned vessels remain safe, reliable, compliant and operationally ready through effective technical oversight and planned maintenance

• Lead repairs and dry dockings: Plan and oversee repairs, upgrades and dry-docking projects, managing safety, quality, cost and schedule

• Maintain compliance: Prepare vessels for class and statutory surveys, audits, SIRE inspections and oil-major requirements, ensuring timely closure of findings

• Strengthen reliability: Monitor machinery condition, recurring defects and equipment performance, driving corrective and preventive actions

• Control budgets: Manage vessel operating and dry-docking budgets, balancing technical requirements with cost-effective solutions

• Support onboard teams: Work closely with Masters and Chief Engineers, conduct vessel visits and provide practical guidance on technical and maintenance matters

• Respond to incidents: Coordinate technical support during breakdowns and emergencies, including troubleshooting, repairs, investigations and follow-up actions

• Collaborate across functions: Partner with Marine Operations, Crewing, Procurement, HSSEQ and Commercial teams to support safe and efficient vessel operations

• Drive improvement: Share lessons learned and contribute to fleet-wide improvements in safety, reliability, efficiency and technical standards

Are you part of the solution?

At Maersk Tankers, you can come as you are and be among people who will expand your horizon. As our new Technical Superintendent, we do, however, expect that you can contribute with the following:

• Degree in Marine Engineering or equivalent; Class 1 marine Engineer Certificate is preferred

• Minimum 3-5 years of shore-based experience as Technical Superintendent or sailing experience as Chief Engineer on oil/chemical and gas tankers

• Strong knowledge of tanker operations, marine engineering systems, PMS and international regulations

• Experience with dry-docking, major repairs and budget management

• Excellent communication, problem-solving and leadership skills

• Ability to travel internationally and attend vessels, sometimes on short notice

You have technical expertise in tanker operations and have a safety and compliance mindset. You are able to prioritise effectively and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment. You have analytical skills and understand budget and cost control. You collaborate effectively with teams and manage stakeholders with transparency and respect.

For further information about the role connect with Santosh Khosla at Santosh.Kumar.Khosla@maersktankers.com.

Job Title: Senior Director, Corporate Procurement

Department: Corporate Procurement

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**Shape the future of a diverse, business-critical portfolio, strengthen an experienced leadership team and raise the bar for global category excellence. You will challenge established approaches, unlock cross-category opportunities and use commercial judgement, strategic partnerships and AI-enabled insights to make our procurement decisions smarter, faster and more valuable.

As our new Senior Director, you will set the global procurement direction for the services and technologies that enable Novo to operate, innovate and grow. You will lead one of our three global category clusters called Corporate Services. The cluster covers Professional Services, External Workforce and Digital Solutions with approximately DKK 20 billion in annual spend.

**What You’ll Do

**Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Procurement (reporting to CFO), you will join Corporate Procurement Management and lead the Corporate Services cluster through three experienced team leaders (two Directors and one Associate Director) and their 23-person teams in Denmark, who drive category management and strategic sourcing. You will work closely with our Category Management Support function and our Global Business Services teams in Bangalore (India), which manage tactical sourcing.

**You Will

**

• Lead through others: Set direction, empower your leaders and build a culture of accountability, honest feedback, development and constructive challenge.

• Drive global category excellence: Set the cluster’s strategic direction, connect business priorities with market opportunities and enable ambitious category strategies that deliver measurable value.

• Unlock cross-category opportunities: Find synergies across the three categories and challenge how we access expertise, deploy technology and partner externally to strengthen competitiveness, flexibility and innovation.

• Shape demand and business opportunities: Anticipate evolving needs, challenge established commercial and delivery models, and build the senior partnerships and sponsorship to turn opportunities into results.

• Advance AI-enabled category excellence: Use technology, data and AI to deepen market intelligence, accelerate decisions, automate lower-value work and raise the impact of category management.

• Strengthen strategic supplier ecosystems: Build partnerships that bring innovation and critical capabilities while improving commercial value, performance, sustainability and resilience.

**Who You’ll Work With

**Corporate Procurement is a global strategic function with an ambitious cost, innovation and value agenda. We manage Novo’s indirect spend, supplier base and global Source-to-Pay processes and systems, with teams in Bagsværd, Bangalore and Boston and category and sourcing managers across the globe.

We bridge business priorities with market opportunities and supplier capabilities, using market intelligence, AI and automation to move faster, decide better and deliver greater enterprise value.

You will partner with colleagues across Corporate Procurement and senior stakeholders Enterprise IT, People & Organisation, Legal, Finance and other business areas, as well as regional procurement colleagues and senior executives at strategic suppliers.

As part of Corporate Procurement Management, you will also help shape the wider procurement agenda, build and grow the future leadership of the organisation, strengthen cross-category collaboration and build a more intelligent, agile and high-performing organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an accomplished procurement and people leader with deep domain expertise, strategic perspective and strong business partnering skills. Above all, you succeed through others: setting clear direction and enabling experienced leaders and experts to make sound decisions, grow and deliver together.

You have a clear view of how procurement creates enterprise value and use market insight, supplier capabilities and internal expertise to shape opportunities with the business.

**To Succeed, You Will Bring

**

• Solid experience in category management and global strategic procurement.

• A strong record as a leader of leaders, delivering results, developing experienced category leaders and experts, and driving high engagement organisations.

• Deep category expertise across complex indirect spend, with strong credibility in at least one of Professional Services, External Workforce or Digital/IT and sound understanding of the others.

• Proven ability to partner with and constructively challenge senior executives, aligning a global matrix organisation around shared outcomes.

• Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic supplier relationships and transformation, balancing value, quality, innovation, agility and risk.

• Experience leveraging shared services and specialist capabilities in global procurement operating models to maximise strategic capacity and performance.

• Strong analytical judgement and financial acumen, with an understanding of how AI, automation and advanced analytics improve procurement intelligence, productivity and decisions.

You combine curiosity, courage and commercial judgement, and coach others through difficult decisions with clarity, care and integrity.

**What You Can Expect

**You will lead one of our most diverse and strategically important global portfolios, influencing how Novo accesses critical expertise, technology and supplier innovation. With ~DKK 20 billion in annual spend, an experienced leadership team and direct access to senior decision-makers, you will have the scale and mandate to make a real difference.

Our Corporate Procurement organisation has high ambitions for category excellence and enterprise value, and we value leaders who bring new perspectives, challenge conventional thinking and raise the bar for themselves and their teams.

Guided by the Novo Way, we create focus and speed through clear priorities, simple ways of working and decisive action. We care for our people, show respect and never compromise on safety and ethics.

As part of a strong procurement leadership community, you will broaden your enterprise perspective, develop other leaders and keep growing as a senior executive.

**Start now

**Ready to shape global category excellence, develop outstanding leaders and connect business ambition with market opportunity?

Apply for the Senior Director, Corporate Procurement role by November 22, 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV.

For further information, please contact Executive Search Advisor Kristoffer Baadsgaard at +45 30 77 56 05.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Position, purpose & impact:

**We're looking for an experienced Senior People & Culture Business Partner to be the main P&C partner for our Go-To-Market organization, with a special focus on our US team. You'll be the go-to HR expert for the US, so you need solid, hands-on experience with US HR practices, benefits and systems.

Working closely with our CRO and GTM leaders, you'll strengthen performance, leadership and engagement across the business. You'll also support organizational development, talent decisions and change initiatives. You'll be based in our Copenhagen office, support US colleagues across time zones and travel to the US about every second month. Your work will help build the high-performing, trust-based culture that drives Queue-it's growth.

**Your toolkit:

**

• Several years of experience as an HR Business Partner in a senior role, including organizational. development and performance management.

• Previous hands-on HR experience supporting employees and leaders in the US.

• Solid knowledge of US employment practices, employee relations, benefits and HR administration.

• Practical experience with US HR systems and providers, such as TriNet or similar.

• Confidence to coach and challenge leaders while building trusted advisory relationships.

• Strong facilitation and communication skills across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Experience with stakeholder, project and change management.

• An analytical mindset that turns people insights into clear business recommendations.

• Experience supporting global organizations across cultures and time zones.

• Willingness to work US hours when needed and travel to the US about every second month.

**The role in action:

**

• Partner with our CRO and GTM leaders on performance management, talent development and organizational effectiveness.

• Act as the go-to HR expert for our US organization, advising on employment practices, benefits, employee relations and HR administration.

• Give practical guidance on policies and compliance, and bring in external legal experts when needed.

• Coach and support managers through people decisions across the whole employee lifecycle.

• Facilitate performance dialogues, feedback processes and development conversations that lift individual and team performance.

• Run leadership development initiatives and employee development programs across GTM.

• Drive engagement initiatives and help leaders act on employee feedback, together with the wider P&C team.

• Support organizational changes and make sure communication and stakeholder alignment stay strong throughout.

• Contribute to P&C projects and strategic initiatives that support business priorities.

• Spend regular time with our US team, both remotely across time zones and on-site in the US.

**Why join the Queue

****Your Copenhagen base

**Most of your time will be at our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen, Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The space is designed for both teamwork and focus, with open work areas, quiet rooms and dedicated spaces for deep work. You'll also spend regular time in the US, travelling there about every second month to work side by side with our US team. In between visits, you'll stay closely connected to them across time zones.

**How We Work

**At Queue-it, you’re trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strengths-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You’ll be part of a global team with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives, open dialogue, and cross-cultural collaboration are part of everyday work.

**Community and everyday life

**We make time to connect, with regular social activities, ping pong, foosball, daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building. It’s a workplace that balances professional growth with a strong sense of community.

**What We’re About

**At Queue-it, we help leading brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events, creating fairer, more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

We’re also a global team of 40+ nationalities working across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in trust - in the digital experiences we protect and in the culture we build together.

Here, we take a strengths-based approach, encouraging people to do what they naturally do best. You’ll join a supportive environment where individuality is valued and collaboration matters.

And yes, we like to have fun. From monthly events to cultural celebrations and learning initiatives, we make time to connect, recognize one another, and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

Key about your role

As a Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

You will have responsibility of tasks that include:

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks.

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations.

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders.

• Supporting in quality assurance, through testing and bug intake.

Key About you

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, customers and calculations, and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field.

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership, and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Experience gathering and breaking down complex requirements into actionable tasks within IT projects.

• Communicate confidently in English.

Using AI

• You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects.

What we offer

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000-60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

*A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to Martin Bo Heiberg, manager martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

**About OrderYOYO

**We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

**Purpose of the role

**You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

**Key Responsibilities

****Programme leadership

**

• Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.

• Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.

• Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

**Pre-completion and Day 1

**

• Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.

• Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.

• Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

****Data and systems

• Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

**Customer migration

**

• Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.

• Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.

• Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.

• Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.

• Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

****Stakeholders

• Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

**Commercial outcomes and reporting

**

• Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.

• Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

**Skills And Experience Required

**

• 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.

• Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.

• Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.

• Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.

• Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.

• Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.

• Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.

• Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.

• Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.

• A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

**What We Offer

**

• A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.

• Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.

• Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.

• Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Program Manager – Product Development
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Product Development at SimCorp is building a Strategic Program Management capability from the ground up. We are a 3,000-person fintech on a mission to be the world's leading investment management platform, and Product Development, our largest organizational unit with around 1,600 people, is where the work gets done. Programs and projects of real strategic consequence are already in motion.

This role sits within the Strategy & Transformation team, working directly alongside the Senior Director of Strategy & Execution. You will help drive a portfolio of cross-functional programs and projects spanning AI strategy execution, engineering tooling, process transformation, compliance, and platform migration. The work is varied, consequential, and visible at the most senior levels.

If you are a hands-on program manager who thrives on complexity, builds structure in ambiguous environments, and gets things done across a matrixed organization by building trust and collaborating across teams, this is your role.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Own delivery of a defined set of cross-functional programs and projects from the Product Development portfolio, with full accountability for outcomes, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.

• Role model, define and drive how Strategic Program Management operates inside Product Development, with regard to standards, tools, and ways of working.

• Coach and assist colleagues leading programs and projects in PD.

• Coordinate across Product Management, Platform, and Application Engineering to resolve cross-functional dependencies and keep delivery on track and aligned to our strategic goals.

• Partner with Change & Organizational Development and the wider organization where programs require shifts in ways of working or organizational behavior.

The current portfolio of initiatives spans AI transformation, platform migration and tooling, delivery model transformation, change of ways of working, and compliance and risk governance. These are live initiatives with delivery pressure, cross-unit dependencies, and direct visibility at CPTO and senior leadership level. Initiatives vary in scale and complexity, and the mix evolves with Product Development's strategic priorities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are an experienced, hands-on and pragmatic program manager who combines structured thinking with the interpersonal confidence to drive accountability in a matrixed organization. You know that getting things done in a matrixed organization depends on understanding what other teams need, not just what you need from them. That takes investment in relationships, not just process, and you invest in both.

You are comfortable holding multiple programs or projects simultaneously, switching between strategic and operational thinking as the situation demands. You produce crisp updates and governance material, and you escalate early rather than late.

The combination of technical tooling, AI strategy, process optimization, and compliance work in this portfolio does not intimidate you. You do not need to be the subject matter expert. You need to be the person who ensures the right people are in the room and the work moves forward in a collaborative way. Ambiguity and competing demands do not unsettle you. You find the practical path and bring people with you.

WHAT WE VALUE

• 6+ years in program or project management roles, ideally with some years within a technology or product development organization.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholder engagement.

• Experience across both structured program management (governance, planning, risk management) and delivery-focused project execution.

• Experience building or improving program management practices, governance, and ways of working that teams and senior leaders use.

• Familiarity with engineering tooling environments and the ability to coordinate technical migrations or platform implementations without being the technical lead.

• Experience with compliance-related programs (GDPR, RoPA, ERM) is a plus.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You produce crisp executive material and inspire confidence in senior leadership forums.

• A direct, structured, and collaborative working style. You build alignment without softening the hard conversations.

• Degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.

BENEFITS

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Join a leading international life science company in an exciting role and assume end-to-end responsibility for a high-impact role at the intersection of operational strategy and execution.

Lead a Complex Global Clinical Study with strategic impact

As Clinical Trial Program Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the company’ clinical development strategy. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Operations, you will assume responsibility for a strategically important Global Clinical Study while influencing the future direction of the company’s development portfolio.

Operating in an outsourced model, you will provide strategic oversight of CROs and external partners, ensuring clinical programs are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance, timelines, and budget. You will serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, driving cross-functional decision-making, managing program risks, and translating development objectives into successful execution.

Beyond study delivery, you will contribute to lifecycle management, portfolio development, and the evaluation of future business opportunities, combining scientific insight, business acumen, and operational excellence to create long-term value. This is a highly visible role offering a rare combination of strategic influence, broad organizational exposure, and ownership of complex global development activities.

Global Clinical Study Leadership in an outsourced setup

You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry and a proven track record of leading complex global clinical development programs. Operating in fully outsourced environments, you have successfully provided strategic oversight of CROs and external partners while maintaining accountability for quality, timelines, budgets, and study outcomes.

You combine a strong understanding of clinical development, global regulatory requirements, and ICH-GCP with the ability to translate scientific and business objectives into executable strategies. With sound business acumen and a strategic mindset, you are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex matrix organizations, and driving cross-functional decisions that create value and accelerate delivery.

Personally, you thrive in environments characterized by complexity, accountability, and change. You balance strategic perspective with operational pragmatism, bringing sound judgment, resilience, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. Through credibility and collaboration, you create alignment across stakeholders and build momentum around shared objectives.

Most importantly, you are motivated by shaping the direction of clinical development programs, challenging established thinking, and delivering meaningful outcomes for patients, the business, and the broader development portfolio.

Become Part of an Ambitious Growth Journey

This is an opportunity to join an international and innovation-driven life science organization at an exciting stage of development. You will have significant influence on critical clinical studies and work closely with senior stakeholders across the business, helping to shape future development activities and strategic priorities. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will lead the safety surveillance strategy for responses to Health Authority questions across Novo’s incretin portfolio, mainly within diabetes and obesity treatment. You will drive benefit–risk thinking, influence critical decisions and represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings. Your judgement helps ensure the safety of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases is understood clearly and communicated on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced, scientifically driven colleague who thrives on complex safety challenges and turns data into meaningful insight.

**We Imagine You Have

**

• A master’s degree in Life Sciences (e.g. Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Medicine or Biology).

• Extensive experience within drug safety, pharmacovigilance, drug development processes, global regulatory requirements, GxP standards and medical concepts.

• Demonstrated ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and translate them into clear, actionable steps.

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence decisions through clear, concise communication.

• Solid experience with Health Authority negotiations, including meetings.

• The ability to communicate clearly, in writing and verbally, and to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach: you work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when situations or priorities change.

• A team-player mindset: you show empathy, take care of colleagues, build effective connections and collaborate seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead high-impact activities across the incretin portfolio, help set the direction for safety surveillance, and act as a trusted safety leader for key stakeholders. Clear communication, sound judgement and taking ownership will be part of your everyday work.

• Act as the safety surveillance lead for strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from all Health Authority interactions.

• Maintain overview of activities, including studies, submissions and questions and answers from Health Authorities.

• Represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings.

• Maintain overview of safety contributions to study reports, regulatory submissions, protocols and other key documents, and ensure relevant input to continued development activities.

• Contribute to benefit–risk communication and ensure clear, aligned and timely safety messaging for internal stakeholders and Health Authorities.

• Drive governance and decision-making across cross-functional areas and senior fora, and mentor colleagues by setting standards for scientific quality, decision-making and collaboration.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Post-Marketing Cardiometabolic III team in Safety Surveillance Post-Marketing, an area within Global Patient Safety based in Søborg, Denmark, with a department in Bangalore, India. The area has global responsibility for the portfolio of marketed products and consists of 7 teams across Denmark and India.

As a team, we are the bridge between clinical development and post-marketing. We handle clinical studies and submissions and lead strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from Health Authorities around the world on our GLP-1 portfolio.

You will work both independently and through others, building strong partnerships with colleagues across Clinical Development, Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics and other functional areas. Medical & Science will be a particularly close partner, and together you will keep decisions timely and scientific quality high. The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly science driven. We value diverse perspectives, because the strongest outcomes emerge when people with different experiences and expertise work together.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and lead from the front, while informally guiding junior colleagues and growing alongside highly skilled, enthusiastic colleagues. You will work at the intersection of science, drug development and regulatory strategy, with room to keep building your expertise through relevant learning offerings and experience across functions.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how safety is understood and communicated for treatments that matter to millions of people, apply for the Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist role by **15 November 2026.

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Department: Managed Services

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Responsibilities

**

**Why should you choose HSO International?

****Development and growth

**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**Fun and success

**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**International project exposure

**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**Freedom and responsibility

**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Knowledge of carbon credit and allowance allocation is a plus.

• Experience and interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is highly valued.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply: If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

Graeme Marsh

Business Director at JSS Search, specialising in Senior & Executive Finance recruitment across London’s Technology, SaaS and Data Markets

We are partnering exclusively with our Private Equity client as they build out their new Commercial Finance capability to support the next phase of growth. This is highly commercial leadership role, embedded within the business and partnering directly with senior operational and commercial stakeholders - rather than sitting within a traditional reporting function, you'll operate at the heart of decision-making, helping leadership teams navigate growth, complexity and change while shaping how commercial performance is understood and managed across the organisation.

As Commercial Finance Director, you will act as the senior commercial sparring partner to your leadership team, turning financial and operational data into clear insights that drive action. You'll identify the key drivers behind performance, challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic opportunities and ensure investment, pricing and resource decisions are grounded in sound commercial thinking. Working closely with business leaders, you'll build robust business cases, highlight risks and opportunities before they emerge in reported results, and create greater accountability around performance. Success in the role will come from your ability to influence senior stakeholders, balance commercial judgement with analytical rigour, and provide the constructive challenge needed to improve outcomes.

About You

• Experience in Commercial Finance, Strategy, Consulting, Sales Operations or a similarly commercial and analytical environment ideally within the Technology/SaaS industry.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape business decisions.

• Strong commercial acumen with a genuine interest in understanding business performance and growth drivers.

• Comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on analysis.

• Experience partnering with senior operational or commercial leaders.

• Confidence to challenge assumptions, push back where necessary and provide an independent viewpoint.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely.

• Experience in technology, software, recurring revenue, subscription or other data-led business models would be advantageous.
